content_blocks.label: clause_1._PARTIES
content_blocks.text: This action is brought by Sarah J. Thompson, hereinafter referred to as 'Plaintiff', against Evergreen Corp., hereinafter referred to as 'Defendant'.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_STATEMENT_OF_FACTS
content_blocks.text: On July 1, 2024, Plaintiff entered into a contract with Defendant for the delivery of goods, which was breached by Defendant as described below.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._PRAYER_FOR_RELIEF
